intent_en: To explain the concept of progressive taxation where tax rates increase as income levels rise.
previous_intent: To illustrate the concept of progressive taxation by showing that income tax burdens increase from the poorest to the richest population segments, highlighting the debate over whether the wealthy pay their fair share.
narration_support: poor people pay a very small part of their income to the government. And rich people pay more. This concept of taxing the poor at a lower rate and taxing the rich more, this is called progressive taxation.
chart_support: Bar chart showing income tax rates increasing from the poorest to the richest population groups.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly defines progressive taxation and the chart visualizes the increasing tax burden from the poorest to the richest deciles.
